difficulty_reason: Three-way equivalence for restricting a limit-preserving transformation to the Noetherian site: (1) implies (2) by fibre products and lfp permanence; (3) implies (1) by gluing the local solutions X_W over the affine basis with canonical cocycle-compatible isomorphisms from the relative gluing lemma, then constructing each X_W by writing W = lim V'_i, descending the map W -> G' to some V'_i via limit preservation, using representability on the Noetherian V_i, and applying the canonical-extension equivalence.
